source: Legacy motor mapping accepted as correct by Pranav 2026-10-26 (status "accepted"). theta_to_legacy_motor is motor_hip = pitch_L - off, motor_knee = -(pitch_L + knee_L) + K with pitch_L = -theta, knee_L = phi: sign -1 for hip and knee, and the knee encoder follows the hip 1:1 (coupling +1) while the knee joint itself is independent. The reference pose is taken to be the legacy motor-zero pose (theta 134.56 deg, phi 168.82 deg), i.e. the compressed homing stop. Raw references still come from each session's homing. Reproduces the legacy mapping exactly up to a constant (test_legacy_equivalence).
